1.

Jesus, the true image of the Father, The brightness of God’s glory, Eternally shall Thy praise increase Through time and eternity.

2.

Thou who camest from heaven’s heights Down to the depths of sorrow at the cross, To crush the power of darkness, Thee, O Jesus, we worship.

3.

Sing, ye ransomed company, Sing His love without measure. He removed the sting from death And hath risen from the grave.

4.

Sing His glorious ascension, Victorious and wondrous, Sing His majesty upon the throne, His who was so humbled.

5.

Sing His return in the clouds With all the redeemed saints! Earth and heaven loudly proclaim, “The Nazarene” shall reign.
